notes.content:

Add to your wishlist! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4017780/Bratty_Bottoms_2/

Bratty Bottoms 2, is a slice-of-life roommate visual novel with flirty banter, light comedy, and branching relationships. After moving to the city, you find yourself sharing an apartment with the bossy Chloe and her best friend Sophia. Daily choices, routines, and conversations will shape how your bond with them grows, whether it’s friendship, rivalry, or something deeper.

Genre: Visual Novel + Slice of Life + Roommate Romance

Setting: Shared city apartment

Main Role: A newcomer starting fresh in the city, looking for connections and new friendships

Core Loop:
[list]
[*] Spend time with Chloe and Sophia across different times of day
[*] Make dialogue choices that affect trust, tension, and affection
[*] Balance routines, house rules, and personal boundaries
[*] Unlock special story events through growing relationships
[/list]

Romance Paths:

[b]Chloe: A bratty, teasing “boss” who hides a softer, protective side [/b]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44992010/cbc16c1bf73543690f3434cc89b9303674af6baa.png[/img]

[b]Sophia: Playful, shy, and warmhearted, learning to open up while relying on Chloe’s support[/b]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44992010/11646ef21f2149c1d51712b6e5eaceb989837c39.png[/img]

notes.title: Delivery Days is out now!
notes.content:
[h2]Delivery Days[/h2][p align="start"]Sometimes the simplest encounters can change everything.[/p][p align="start"]In Delivery Days, a visual novel about chance meetings and unexpected bonds, you play as an overworked man who begins to find warmth and connection through the people who step into his life—one knock at the door at a time.[/p][p align="start"]Order food, request help, or simply open the door—and you might find more than you expected waiting on the other side.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970456/6d95370c2ee8e76f6c19b197c6ce9645a1bc3c09.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3860730/Delivery_Days/?beta=1"][/dynamiclink]
[b]Features[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]A modern-day romance visual novel with multiple branching routes.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Experience different stories depending on who you open your heart to.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Slice-of-life warmth mixed with emotional twists.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Choices that determine your relationships and endings.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Will you keep things casual, or let your heart get carried away with every delivery?

notes.title: Bratty Bottoms! My upcoming management style erotic visual novel.
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3093570/Bratty_Bottoms/
Welcome to Bratty Bottoms!
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44992010/6f8535c2745aa87b9ce8b442ba464ac69f8089b6.png[/img]
   A charming visual novel with management-style game mechanics where you transform a struggling motel into a bustling success. Play as a hardworking newcomer hired to help manage the family-owned motel, run by the bratty yet endearing Lila.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44992010/ff5e336f64633b14028666ab5fb8ac5279347867.png[/img]
In this players, Build relationships, tackle daily challenges, and improve the motel's reputation while dealing with Lila's demanding nature and making new friends, like the bubbly intern Nicole and more!
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44992010/cb983502889c4f3b25dfb21961727032cc002252.png[/img]
Experience an engaging story filled with humor, heart, and the satisfaction of turning a rundown business into a thriving hotspot. Your choices matter—will you earn Lila's trust and friendship, or will you struggle under her tough exterior?

✦ Unique character interactions and evolving relationships.
✦ Management-style game mechanics
✦ Customizable outfits and an in-game shop for various upgrades.
✦ A heartwarming story of growth, friendship, and transformation.

notes.title: My upcoming game Kindvixens steam page is out now!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2926220/Kindvixens/


Sit a spell, stranger! Come to the little town of Seabreeze for a visual novel filled with love, community, and just a hint of mystery to pull it all together!


Bet you’re just itching to meet everyone. We have a whole host of fun characters, among them are about 11 women, all of differing personalities, all brought to life through hand-drawn, lovingly made, anime-inspired art! Come meet them and the rest of the cast as the story comes together.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44992010/953cf317aed3c18bee3816cae237f1ffaae88bd2.gif[/img]

How does one find these girls? Don’t think too hard about it. Seabreeze ain’t the kind of town that will breathe down your neck to make you find everything. The story you get here is straightforward and simple. If you wanna find the girls, you’ll find them easily enough if you put your ear to the ground. Beyond them, there are quite a fair bit of locations for you to explore. Just keep your nose to the ground though, you never know who or what you might find in a little town like this.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44992010/e2490614bbc71f7ea5f9457de7f4a1fb6e0e7ec9.gif[/img]

Ah, you’re wondering more about the ladies here eh? Well, they’re a kindly sort. Most love to meet new people, and each one comes with an interesting host of quirks and needs. Some might help you get jobs, others will need things from you, but all of them are looking for something in life…and who knows, that something might just be you. Careful though…who knows what secrets these girls might be keeping about themselves…or the town itself.

So come along, meet them…and who knows, someone might get a little lucky, eh?
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44992010/46eed1662a7218a9473c09b52078da90c2bd6cff.gif[/img]



Featuring:

[b]11 unique, charming and kinky ladies
Very Lite Survival Mechanics!
Minigames!
Make decisions about the relationships you make
Become part of the local community and help the townsfolk!
Solve the mystery plaguing the town![/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/SFNqP3g4ST]Join our discord,
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44992010/bc9c3d7dba8bee1cce0353df2eb65ba77979ecd6.gif[/img]  [/url]


Thank you, 
Pookie.

Live through the straightforward stories of Our Protagonist and her Friends!
Hand-drawn Anime Art
Every character in the game has been hand-drawn
Episodic Gameplay
Each episode focuses on one love interest, but be aware that accessing some romantic paths requires specific choices.
